title: Ampleness can be checked on a closed subscheme with the same underlying space
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of Noetherian schemes (each locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]; schemes as in [def-pc-scheme]) such that the underlying continuous map of $i$ is a homeomorphism of $Z$ onto $X$. Let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $i^*\mathcal L$ its pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] (an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module). Then $i^*\mathcal L$ is ample on $Z$ if and only if $\mathcal L$ is ample on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].

proof.text: If L is ample on X, the closed immersion i is affine, so the existing affine tensor-pullback ampleness theorem gives ampleness of i*L.

The proved private helper exists_ker_pow_eq_bot proves nilpotence without coherent-module machinery. Surjectivity of i makes the support of its kernel all of X; the ideal is contained in its radical, which equals the nilradical. Take a finite affine open cover. Each section ring is Noetherian, hence its kernel ideal is finitely generated and contained in the nilradical. Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical, proved from the radical-power lemma, gives a killing exponent on each affine. The maximum kills on every member of the finite cover; IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top gives i.ker^N = bottom globally. The empty cover is included.

The proved private helper isAmple_of_ker_pow_eq_bot inducts on n with i.ker^(n+2) = bottom. For n=0 the square-zero lifting theorem applies directly. For the successor, let K=i.ker^2 and k: Y=K.subscheme -> X. Mathlib constructs this closed immersion with k.ker=K. Since K <= i.ker, IsClosedImmersion.lift constructs j: Z -> Y with j >> k=i; j is a closed immersion because its composite with k is. Local Noetherianity of Y follows from k being locally of finite type, and compactness follows from k being quasi-compact over compact X.

The proved private helper ker_square_eq_bot_of_comp shows j.ker^2=bottom. On every affine open U of X, the composite kernel ideal is the comap of the kernel ideal of j under k.app U. This ring map is surjective, so the kernel of j is its image. Taking ideal squares commutes with ideal map. The square of the composite kernel is k.ker, and its image under k.app U is zero. The affine inverse images cover Y, giving global square-zero vanishing.

For M=k*L, invertibility of both M and j*M follows from invertible_pullback_tensor. nonempty_tensorPullbackComp j k and j >> k=i identify i*L with j*M. Ampleness invariance under this module isomorphism transfers the hypothesis, and square-zero lifting gives ampleness of M on Y.

For the successor case i.ker^(n+3)=bottom, the kernel of k has (n+2)-nd power i.ker^(2*(n+2)), which vanishes since n+3 <= 2*(n+2). The induction hypothesis for k now proves L ample on X. Finally an arbitrary killing exponent N from the second step also kills exponent N+2 by antitonicity of ideal powers, so the helper applies. Together with affine pullback this proves the unchanged equivalence.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks 09MS (coherent.tex line 4737, tag verified in tags/tags) and its proof. Step 1: forward direction by 0892 (existing node lem-weil-pbc-pullback-ample-invertible) since a closed immersion is finite hence affine (Mathlib leaf). Steps 2-7: the first paragraph of the proof, written out: the ideal sheaf I is nilpotent by 01Y9 (existing node lem-weil-pbc-coherent-support-power-ideal-kills, applied to F=O_X, coherent by 01XZ, with V(I)=i(Z)=X); the closed subschemes Z_k cut out by I^k (existing Mathlib leaves 01HO/01QO), each Noetherian and homeomorphic to X, the closed immersions Z_{k-1}->Z_k with square-zero ideal I^{k-1}/I^k (computed on affines), the pullbacks L_k=i_k^*L with j_k^*L_k = L_{k-1}, and the induction (base, step, conclusion) which the source compresses into 'In this way we reduce to the case that I^2=0'. The square-zero case (the second and third paragraphs of the proof, using 01QY, 0B8S, 01XR (via 09MR) and 01YQ) is one new unsplit node, lem-sc-ample-square-zero-thickening, strictly weaker in hypotheses than the item's (I^2=0 instead of a homeomorphism). Statement unchanged; it agrees with 09MS hypothesis by hypothesis. No sorry-free slopmaster2 declaration states the item or the new node (grep of WeilConjectures and Comparator for the id, 09MS, ample with thickening/nilpotent/homeomorphism; the only ample-on-reduction Lean is Modules/AmpleReduced.lean, Stacks 0BD4 (3), ample families in characteristic p, another statement).
